commits.message: fix: force function redeploy with updated build comment
fix: remove REMOVED campaign filter and use yesterday as untilStr in connectors
fix: align date ranges with ad platforms (toDate=yesterday) and remove all_conversions inflation
fix: AI Briefing scoped to selected period - cache, prompt and reset on period change
feat: move BudgetOpportunitySection from ROI to Campaigns page
fix: ROI page uses bucketOverlapFraction and aggregates conversionActions for correct period metrics
feat: shared persistent period selector for Dashboard and ROI pages
fix: dashboard uses bucketOverlapFraction for correct period metrics (same as Campaigns page)
feat: dashboard period selector (current month / last 30d / current year)
fix: consistent conversion metrics, brand-scoped filters, AI briefing brand reset
fix(meta): remove omni_purchase - causes 1600%+ CTR due to modeled conversions inflation
fix: recompute ROAS from cv/spent in frontend, never trust stale roas:0 from Firestore
fix: round all currency amounts to 0 decimals in Campaigns page
perf: cache-first campaigns load via Firestore IndexedDB + skip localStorage for large queries
fix(campaigns): proportional scaling for monthly Meta buckets in date filter
